join.notScheduled: not open: join.opens-at is not set
join.revokeHint: To revoke: raise join.revision in the course config and hand out the new link.

join.title: Get your lab repository
join.description: Sign in with GitHub. The service will create a private repository from the template or restore access to an existing repository.
join.successDescription: Open the repository. If the invitation is still pending, GitHub will offer to accept it on that page.

errors.oauthDenied: You cancelled GitHub authorization. You can try again.
errors.oauthFailed: GitHub could not confirm the sign-in. Start authorization again.
errors.oauthNotConfigured: The teacher has not configured GitHub sign-in for this service yet.
errors.oauthStateExpired: The GitHub sign-in has expired. Return to the lab link and try again.
errors.notFound: The course or lab was not found. Check the link.
errors.notConfigured: A template repository has not been configured for this lab.
errors.templateUnavailable: The template repository is not accessible to the server. Contact the teacher.
errors.repositoryFailed: The repository could not be created or checked. Please try again.
errors.createForbidden: Not enough permissions to create the repository. Please contact your teacher.
errors.accessFailed: The repository is ready, but its current invitation could not be checked. Please try again.
errors.invitationFailed: The repository invitation could not be sent. Try later or contact the teacher.
errors.rateLimit: GitHub temporarily limited requests or invitations. Please try again later.
errors.githubUnavailable: GitHub could not be reached. Check the connection and try again.
errors.invalidRepositoryLink: The server returned an invalid repository link. Start again.
errors.templateMustBePrivate: The template repository is misconfigured. Contact the teacher.
errors.forkTimeout: GitHub is still creating the repository. Refresh the page in a minute.
errors.actionsEnableFailed: Could not enable checks in the repository. Contact the teacher.
errors.nameTaken: A repository with this name is already taken. Contact the teacher.
errors.forkCheckFailed: Could not verify the repository. Please try again in a few minutes.
errors.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Try again or contact the teacher.
errors.notATeamLab: This lab is done individually, not as a team.
errors.sessionRequired: Your sign-in session has expired. Sign in with GitHub again.
errors.teamsUnavailable: Could not get the list of teams from GitHub. Try again in a minute.
errors.teamNotFound: Team not found. Refresh the list of teams.
errors.alreadyInTeam: You are already in a team for this lab. Contact your teacher to change teams.
errors.teamFull: This team has no free places left. Pick another one.
errors.teamLimitReached: The maximum number of teams has been reached. Join one of the existing teams.
errors.titleTaken: A team with this name already exists. Pick another name.
errors.invalidTitle: The team name is not acceptable. Check its length and remove unusual characters.
errors.slugRace: Someone created a team at the same moment. Please try again.
errors.titleTooShort: The team name must be at least 3 characters long.
errors.titleTooLong: The team name must be at most 60 characters long.
errors.titleHasSeparator: The team name must not contain “ — ”.
errors.descriptionTooLong: The team description must be at most 200 characters long.
errors.linkNotFound: This link was not found or is no longer valid. Check the address or ask your instructor for a new link.
errors.notOpen: The assignment behind this link is not open yet.
errors.closed: This link no longer hands out repositories. Access to a repository you already have is restored through the same link.

team.landing: Sign in with GitHub to see this lab's teams and join one of them, or create your own.
team.pickDescription: Join your groupmates' team or create your own. One repository per team, shared by all its members.
team.empty: There are no teams yet. Create the first one.
team.pendingHint: The student has not accepted the invitation yet, but the place is already taken.
team.expiredHint: The invitation has expired, but the place is still taken. The student can restore access through the lab link; the teacher can free the place.
team.membersUnknown: The team roster is unavailable right now. Refresh the page in a minute.
team.descriptionPlaceholder: What the team is working on
team.creationClosed: Creating new teams is closed. Join one of the existing teams.
team.creationClosedLimit: The maximum number of teams ({{count}}) has been reached. Join one of the existing teams.
team.memberHint: If the repository invitation never arrived or has expired, press “Restore access” and it will be sent again.

secret.notOpen: The assignment is not open yet. The link will start working once your instructor publishes it.
secret.notOpenAt: The assignment is not open yet. The link will start working on {{moment}}.
secret.closed: Submissions are closed: no new repository is created through this link. If you already have one, sign in with GitHub and your access will be restored.
secret.closedAt: Submissions closed on {{moment}}: no new repository is created through this link. If you already have one, sign in with GitHub and your access will be restored.
